LESSON: WRITING 7.5.1 COMPOSITION WRITING: WRITING PROCESS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.5: Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing: Writing Process
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing: Writing Process, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should one prepare before beginning to write a composition?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 7.5.1 Composition Writing: Writing Process together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: Learner develops the skill of connecting using technology as they share the compositions using a digital device for

peer review.

● Creativity and Imagination: is developed as learners mind-map the idea to be written in the narrative composition using the writing

process.

Values:
Responsibility: is enhanced as learners care for the digital devices used.

Link to other Subjects

The learner is able to relate the skills used in composition writing to their learning in Kiswahili or Kenya Sign Language.

Suggested Learning Resources

Adapted Course books, Flash cards, Recording devices e.g. tablets and mobile phones, Dictionary, Internet, Signed audio-visual recordings,
